question: What claim is being made here about the totality of fields in relation to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs?
premises: All earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs are in question.
A group of all fields is predicated in relation to them.
The relation is one of totality.
inference: The total group of fields belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the relation between yoginīs and fields is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The whole group of fields belongs to all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
